entities.summary: There are two towns in Malaysia called Bandar Tun Razak. This page describes the township and parliamentary constituency in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. For the town of the same name in Pahang, see Bandar Tun Razak, Jengka. Both are named after the second Prime Minister of Malaysia, Tun Abdul Razak.
